display.purpose: Headlines and large numerals only, always uppercase.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy and interactive UI text.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Button and link hover state shifts; the system's only authored motion on this surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #3f9a4b; color: #0a1420; border-radius: 2px; padding: 14px 24px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #63b869; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #63b869; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Availability Slot
components.description: Signature dual-coded hour tile: available (green + dot), booked (muted + X), selected (amber + dot).
components.html: 8 PM
components.css: .ds-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid; padding: 10px 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-slot-available { color: #63b869; border-color: rgba(63,154,75,0.4); background: rgba(63,154,75,0.1); } .ds-slot-booked { color: rgba(251,244,230,0.4); border-color: rgba(251,244,230,0.1); background: rgba(251,244,230,0.04); } .ds-slot-selected { color: #f2b95a; border-color: #f2b95a; background: rgba(242,185,90,0.15); }

components.name: Facility Panel
components.description: Navy panel showing a sport's court/field count.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #0e1e30; color: #fbf4e6; border: 2px solid #0e1e30; border-radius: 2px; padding: 24px; } .ds-panel-count { font-family: 'Anton', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-panel h3 { font-family: 'Anton', Impact, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 32px; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(251,244,230,0.25); padding-top: 16px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Labeled text input used in the booking checkout, with an error state in Stamp Red.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(14,30,48,0.7); } .ds-field-input { margin-top: 6px; width: 100%; border: 2px solid rgba(14,30,48,0.25); border-radius: 2px; background: #fbf4e6; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0e1e30; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0e1e30; } .ds-field-input.ds-field-error { border-color: #a8412c; }

components.name: Stepper Step
components.description: One step of the 3-step booking progress indicator: numbered, active, or done with a drawn checkmark.
components.html: Build Booking
components.css: .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #0e1e30; } .ds-step-dot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(14,30,48,0.1); color: rgba(14,30,48,0.4); } .ds-step-done .ds-step-dot { background: #3f9a4b; color: #0a1420; }

narrative.overview: ML Lifestyle Park's site is built as a barangay court's bulletin wall after dark: bold hand-set signage type, ink-on-paper contrast, and the amber wash of floodlights against a night sky. It refuses both the clean-SaaS booking-form hero and the flat, decoration-free schedule table. Color is full-commitment: navy for authority, cream as the printed paper, green reserved for the single available/go signal from the facility's own logo, amber marking the floodlight night transition. Availability states never rely on color alone.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy condensed display caps (Anton) for every headline
Navy/cream/green fixed brand palette, amber reserved for the night accent
Dot/X iconography doubles every availability color signal
Authored court-line geometry as the only decorative texture
Dashed hairlines as the recurring ticket-stub divider motif

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Court Green means available or primary action and nothing else.

rules.name: The Dual-Coding Rule
rules.body: Every availability state pairs its color with a distinct icon glyph.

rules.name: The Short-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels stay short; longer captions revert to sentence case.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a soft blurred shadow; separation comes from borders and color blocks.

rules.name: The Stamp-Red Rule
rules.body: Red exists only for errors and removals; it never doubles as a fourth availability state or a decorative accent.

dos: Do keep Court Green reserved for available and primary actions only.
Do pair every availability color with a dot/X glyph.
Do set all headlines in Anton, uppercase, at display scale.
Do use authored court-line SVG geometry as the only decorative texture.
Do keep corners near-square (2px) across buttons, cards, and slot tiles.
donts: Don't introduce a color outside Navy / Cream / Green / Amber / Stamp Red.
Don't use Stamp Red for anything other than an error or a removal action.
Don't add drop shadows or soft glows to cards or buttons.
Don't use a pill-shaped or heavily rounded button.
Don't set long, sentence-length copy in uppercase.
Don't replace the labeled hero video placeholder with a stock photo.
